title: Decide what Way Into AI is really about and what gets published where
description:
Rufus (2026-09-23): do a significant pass on the site and decide what is published where. The site currently runs two things side by side: how to USE AI (tools, workflows, agentic coding) and the POLICY/sensemaking side of AI (capabilities, risk, governance, pacing). Is it really two things? What is the site actually about, and should both live here, or should one move elsewhere (e.g. ai.lifeitself.org, Life Itself, a separate newsletter)?

Scope: inventory what is actually being published (ref/, posts/, logs/, use/, understand/) and the real mix of recent entries; test the current dual-route framing in PRODUCT.md and on the homepage (Use AI / Understand AI) against that; propose a one-sentence purpose and audience; decide the publishing map across sites/channels (this site, Substack/new mailing list, Life Itself); then list the consequences for IA, nav and the redesign.

Strategy question for Rufus to decide; produce options + a recommendation, not a restructure. Related: wayintoai-zdw (roles of posts/refs/logs), wayintoai-ll4 (consolidate ai.lifeitself.org sensemaking), wayintoai-cmw (mono theme redesign), wayintoai-b7z (mailing list); prior dual-purpose homepage work in closed wayintoai-1nw.
